build_dataset_tetrominoes: build a tf.data.Dataset from a gzip-compressed TFRecords file using the tetrominoes dataset reader
decode_tfrecords_example: decode a tf.Example proto from a tetrominoes TFRecords file into image, mask, and metadata tensors
read_tetrominoes_tfrecords: read and parse a tetrominoes TFRecords dataset with configurable buffer size and parallel decoding
create_tetrominoes_features: create a feature description dict mapping tetrominoes TFRecord field names to shapes and dtypes
run_tetrominoes_dataset_pipeline: run a tf.data pipeline that reads, decompresses, and decodes tetrominoes TFRecords into image and mask tensors
